- [final.md](ER12_RUNTIME/runs/A6-01/control/stages/reviser/final.md)

The proposal covers all eight obligations and released-plan clauses, and adjudicates C-01 through C-05 with direct primary-source rechecks. Those rechecks confirm the GTFS frequency and DST conditions, the current trip relationships, the SIRI version distinction, and the narrow OTP tests ([GTFS Schedule](https://gtfs.org/documentation/schedule/reference/), [GTFS-RT](https://gtfs.org/documentation/realtime/reference/), [SIRI repository](https://github.com/TransmodelEcosystem/SIRI), [OTP PR #6262](https://github.com/opentripplanner/OpenTripPlanner/pull/6262), [test commit](https://github.com/opentripplanner/OpenTripPlanner/commit/69ac485)). No ferry product validation was performed; pilot checks remain proposed or NOT_RUN.
